summary: Youka is an integrated agricultural management and collaboration platform designed to connect farmers, livestock producers, and agricultural professionals in a single digital ecosystem. It combines farm and crop management, financial planning, water resource optimization, and equipment management with data from NASA and other scientific sources to support smarter decision-making. Through environmental analysis and crop rotation planning, Youka helps improve productivity, optimize resources, and promote sustainable agricultural practices. Built with a modular and scalable approach, it aims to modernize agriculture in the Dominican Republic and expand internationally.
details:
Youka is an agricultural management and collaboration platform designed to help farmers and agricultural professionals manage their activities, analyze environmental data, plan crops, optimize resources, and make informed decisions using NASA and other scientific datasets.It improves agricultural planning, reduces resource waste, supports cost management, and connects farmers with agricultural professionals through a centralized platform.

The intended impact of the project is to modernize agriculture, promote sustainable farming practices, improve productivity, and make scientific information more accessible, starting in the Dominican Republic and expanding internationally.To develop Youka, we used Next.js, React, TypeScript, and NestJS, along with NASA POWER, Sentinel-2, SoilGrids, and other geospatial datasets. GitHub was used for collaboration, Vercel for deployment, and standard computers for development.

Youka is creative because it combines agricultural management, scientific data analysis, decision-support tools, and professional collaboration within a single ecosystem, allowing users to work independently or collaborate when needed.In developing the project, our team considered accessibility, sustainability, environmental conditions, water availability, agricultural costs, ease of use, scalability, and the needs of farmers and agricultural professionals.
